SEARCH
Package net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.builders

Class AbstractQueryUrlBuilder<T extends AbstractQueryUrlBuilder<T>>

java.lang.Object
net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.builders.AbstractQueryUrlBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The concrete builder class.
Direct Known Subclasses:
BraveImageQuery, BraveNewsQuery, BraveSpellcheckQuery, BraveSuggestQuery, BraveVideoQuery, BraveWebQuery
public abstract class AbstractQueryUrlBuilder<T extends AbstractQueryUrlBuilder<T>> extends Object
Abstract base class for building Brave API queries.

Implementations of this class should call addInstanceVertical(SearchVertical) before building, and initialize the builder with clear() before adding options.

The builder will throw AbsentSearchVerticalException if the vertical is not added before building. The builder will also throw UninitializedBuilderException if the builder is not cleared before adding options.

Suggested implementation of factory method: 

    public static BraveWebQuery builder() {
    return new BraveWebQuery().addInstanceVertical(BraveResource.WEB).clear();
  }

The builder will throw AbsentSearchQueryException if the query string is not present in the URL query.

Note: This builder enforces strict URI construction invariants. Subclasses must not override core lifecycle methods. Extension is intended via additional fluent APIs only.

    • isValidQuery

      protected final boolean isValidQuery(@NotNull @NotNull String queryTerm)
      Checks if the given query term is valid.

      A query term is valid if it contains fewer than or exactly 400 characters and less than 50 words. Both limits are enforced conjunctively, in accordance with the Brave Search API documentation.

      Parameters:
      queryTerm - The query term to check.
      Returns:
      true if the query term is valid, false otherwise.

      protected final T addInstanceVertical(@NotNull @NotNull SearchVertical vertical)

      Returns:
      The current instance of the builder.

    • addQueryTerm

      protected final T addQueryTerm(String queryTerm, boolean appendOperator)
      Adds a query term to the URL query and encodes it using UTF-8. If appendOperator is true, the new queryTerm will append to the existing query term in the builder as a search operator, if any.
      Parameters:
      queryTerm - The query term to add.
      appendOperator - Whether or not to interpret queryTerm as search operator and append it to the existing term or save it for later concatenation.
      Returns:
      The current instance of the builder.
